name: Infinite WebGL Gallery
description: Full-screen WebGL strip of images that drifts endlessly and loops, with drag and wheel control, bent planes and an RGB shift that reacts to scroll speed, plus a large centered title.
contents: Horizontal strip of staggered image planes rendered in WebGL
Large centered title over the gallery
behavior: Wheel and drag (mouse or touch) push the scroll with eased inertia
Planes bend and the image channels split in proportion to scroll velocity
Canvas fades in after load and resizes with the container
editableByProps: Images, their layout positions and strip width
Title text, visibility and color, background color
Auto speed, easing, wheel and drag sensitivity and toggles
Bend and RGB shift strength, camera field of view and distance

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how planes bend or how images are cropped

needsCodeEdit.where: h1 element in the showTitle block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and is full width and clipped
Listens for wheel, mouse and touch on the root and window, and removes them on unmount
Drag and touch are captured by the gallery (touch-none), so vertical page scroll by touch starts outside it
Image textures load with crossOrigin anonymous, so image hosts must allow CORS
